description: Find GoVisit destinations by name or travel intent. Use it to identify the right geographic area before exploring its places, activities, or collections. Returns matching destinations with stable codes, canonical links, and the scope searched.

language.description: Requested response language; defaults to the page language.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

mode.description: Name lookup, intent retrieval, or name-first auto discovery.

query.description: Place or destination name, or the traveler's intent.

types.description: Match any of these published classifications; not a size/tier filter.

within.description: Canonical destination code to explore within; all is reserved for an explicit unrestricted place search, never a containing-destination filter.

name: search_destinations

classifications.description: Published classifications; highlight is not a geographic size or tier.

containmentMethod.description: Canonical relation used to establish within scope; parent-chain is disclosed fallback when coverage is absent.

country.description: The country it lies in; null for a country.

region.description: The region it lies in; null for a country or a region.

score.description: Engine-specific ranking signal; compare only within the same match method, not a suitability probability.

title: Search destinations
